body:
REQUEST CHANGES (round 1): #2601 (STORY-1661) at c0d04855a93a69c4327b93de48a53cde5298e169. Fresh strict reviewer; the verdict is recorded.

The design conforms to the signed sketch: C1-C7 and the stall ruling are all met, all 10 new tests pass, and 10/10 targeted mutations are caught. No advisor re-signoff is needed. Two blockers:

**B1. Merge conflict.** `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main` conflicts in `AGENTS.md`, because #2604 (8dd9f48807) also adds a paragraph at line 1. Rebase onto origin/main, keep both paragraphs, and re-run `make check-ci-fast` and the targeted tests.

**B2. The unattended tick fails on states the foreground path deliberately treats as no-ops.** `catch_up_background_at` (history_cache.rs ~:2226) errors with "history index no longer matches this store; run `aida cache rebuild --history`" whenever the index tip is not an ancestor of the store HEAD. That includes two cases where `serve` deliberately does nothing (history_cache.rs ~:1330-1352):
- (a) this checkout's store is BEHIND a shared index that another checkout advanced (BUG-1954 CheckoutBehind), where a rebuild "would reset it under it";
- (b) the tip is still live on another local branch (a diverged checkout).

`handle_tick` passes the error up, so the `history-index-tick` schedule job exits non-zero every 15 minutes. `failure_trip` (maintenance_schedule.rs:3169) records it and can route it to the human inbox as CronJobFailed. The error text also tells the operator to run the rebuild BUG-1954 says not to run.

Required fix: use the same classification as `serve`. In cases (a) and (b), return a successful skip outcome (exit 0, no write). Keep the error and rebuild advice only for genuinely rewritten history or a replaced root.

Required test: in the fixture store, reset HEAD to HEAD~1 while a branch keeps the old tip. Assert that `run_tick` returns the skip outcome, `handle_tick` returns Ok, and `updated_at`/`tip_sha` are unchanged.

Non-blocking (fix if cheap, otherwise say so in the response):
- `--if-behind` has no effect: `--history` alone behaves the same. Either give it a meaning (for example, interactive `--history` reports NotBuilt/Busy and `--if-behind` stays silent) or document that it is only a marker.
- An interactive `aida cache refresh --history` prints nothing for NotBuilt, Busy or UpToDate, ignores `--json`, and resolves the project from cwd only.
- The 30 s deadline is only checked between chunks of at least 256 commits, so a tick can run past it. The scheduler's 120 s kill is the backstop. This is acceptable; a doc note is enough.

Post `FACTORY READY` at the new head when done.
subject: #2601 STORY-1661 REQUEST CHANGES r1 (rebase + tick skip on CheckoutBehind/diverged)
